'''Keenig''' was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> At some point between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Keenig was brutally [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]], which brought her to the attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. The two began a partnership as a result.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keenig was mentioned in the "Shae Vizla: Bounty Hunter" Codex entry in Chapter XIV of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], the [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
